title: Remove Sub-Folders from the Filesystem
summary: Given a list of folder paths, remove all sub-folders within those paths.
statement: Given a list of folder paths, remove all sub-folders within those paths. A sub-folder starts with the parent folder path followed by a '/'. The output can be in any order. A path consists of '/' followed by one or more lowercase letters.
constraints: Paths are distinct absolute folder paths.
Remove every path having another input path as a slash-delimited parent.
hints: Lexicographic sorting places each parent immediately before all descendants.
Keep a path unless it starts with the last kept path plus slash.
A previous surviving parent suppresses its entire contiguous descendant range.
editorial: A previous surviving parent suppresses its entire contiguous descendant range.

tests.explanation: The prefix /a is not a parent of /ab because no slash follows it.
